name: singlet_perturbation_perturbation_effect_estimation
title: Per-perturbation differential expression
description: Estimates, for each perturbation, the change of every gene against matched non-targeting cells, using replicate-level pseudobulk tests by default, with adjusted p-values and a perturbation-level energy distance. Use it after guide assignment and size factors, when replicate labels and raw counts exist. Do not use it to call knockdown efficacy, to judge off-target effects, or to predict unseen perturbations; it writes uns/perturbation_de, uns/perturbation_effects and uns/perturbation_edistance.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Test or strength measure. pseudobulk_nb gives calibrated gene-level tests; edistance gives perturbation-level strength only.

design.description: Study design: layers, labels, replicate and control keys, covariates and the multi-guide rule.

layer.description: Raw integer UMI layer used by pseudobulk_nb.

log_layer.description: Unscaled log-normalised layer used by wilcoxon and by gating.

perturbation_key.description: obs column holding the perturbation label.

control_label.description: Label of non-targeting control cells; required, with no universal default.

replicate_key.description: obs column of biological replicates; the unit of inference.

covariates.description: obs columns added to the pseudobulk design or used as covariates.

multi_guide_rule.description: Cells with two or more guides are excluded, or form their own group; never counted for each guide.

gating.description: Optional Mixscape gating before testing; changes the target to responding cells.

method.description: none tests all assigned cells; mixscape tests Mixscape knockout cells only.

min_de_genes.description: Minimum signature genes before a perturbation is gated.

logfc_threshold.description: Log fold-change cutoff for signature genes.

iter_num.description: Iterations of the two-component mixture fit.

pseudobulk_nb.description: Options of the replicate-level negative-binomial model, the default method.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per pseudobulk; best-practices guideline.

min_counts.description: Minimum total UMI counts per pseudobulk; best-practices guideline.

lfc_shrinkage.description: Store shrunk log2 fold changes for ranking; unshrunk estimates are always kept.

wilcoxon.description: Options of the cell-level Wilcoxon rank-sum comparator, which is not replicate-aware.

logfc_threshold.description: Minimum average log2 fold change for a gene to be tested, as in Seurat.

min_pct.description: Minimum fraction of cells detecting the gene in either group.

edistance.description: Options of the energy-distance strength and stratified permutation test.

embedding_key.description: obsm key of the embedding in which distances are computed.

cells_per_perturbation_cap.description: Maximum perturbed cells sampled per perturbation; the best-practices chapter uses 50.

control_cells_cap.description: Maximum control cells sampled once per screen; a proposed default.

n_perms.description: Label permutations per perturbation, stratified by replicate; resolution is 1/(n+1).

alpha.description: Significance threshold for adjusted p-values of the selected method.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for edistance permutations and control subsampling; other methods are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/perturbation_de. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary: tested and skipped perturbations, dropped pseudobulks, significant pairs and device used. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
